movies.overview: A fast-talking mercenary with a morbid sense of humor is subjected to a rogue experiment that leaves him with accelerated healing powers, and he adopts the alter ego Deadpool.

movies.title: X-Men: Apocalypse
movies.overview: After the re-emergence of the world's first mutant, the world-destroyer Apocalypse, the X-Men must unite to defeat his extinction level plan.

movies.title: Logan
movies.overview: In 2029, mutants are all but extinct. A weary and ailing Logan cares for a crumbling Xavier somewhere on the Mexican border, but Logan's attempts to hide from the world are upended when a young mutant arrives.

movies.title: Deadpool 2
movies.overview: Foul-mouthed mutant mercenary Wade Wilson (a.k.a. Deadpool) assembles a team of fellow mutant rogues to protect a young boy from a time-traveling soldier.

movies.title: Dark Phoenix
movies.overview: Jean Grey begins to develop incredible powers that corrupt and turn her into a Dark Phoenix, causing the X-Men to decide if her life is worth more than all of humanity.

movies.title: The New Mutants
movies.overview: Five young mutants, just discovering their abilities while held in a secret facility against their will, fight to escape their past sins and save themselves.

movies.title: Toy Story
movies.overview: Led by Woody, Andy's toys live happily in his room until Andy's birthday brings Buzz Lightyear onto the scene. Afraid of losing his place in Andy's heart, Woody plots against Buzz.

movies.title: Toy Story 2
movies.overview: When Woody is stolen by a toy collector, Buzz and his friends vow to rescue him, but Woody finds the idea of immortality in a museum tempting.

movies.title: Toy Story 3
movies.overview: Woody, Buzz, and the rest of Andy's toys haven't been played with in years. With Andy about to leave for college, the gang end up at a day-care center where untamed tots with their sticky little hands do not play nice.

movies.title: Toy Story 4
movies.overview: When a new toy called Forky joins Woody and the gang, a road trip alongside old and new friends reveals how big the world can be for a toy.

movies.title: Raiders of the Lost Ark
movies.overview: Daring archaeologist Indiana Jones braves an international and deadly journey to prevent the mystical Ark of the Covenant from falling into Nazi hands.

movies.title: Indiana Jones and the Temple of Doom
movies.overview: After arriving in India, Indiana Jones is asked by a desperate village to find a mystical stone. He agrees — and stumbles upon a secret cult plotting a terrible plan in the catacombs of an ancient palace.

movies.title: Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade
movies.overview: When Dr. Henry Jones Sr. suddenly goes missing while pursuing the Holy Grail, eminent archaeologist Indiana Jones must venture to the heart of the Third Reich.

movies.title: Indiana Jones and the Kingdom of the Crystal Skull
movies.overview: Set during the Cold War, archaeologist Indiana Jones must battle Soviet agents determined to harness the power of a mysterious crystal skull.

movies.title: Indiana Jones and the Dial of Destiny
movies.overview: Archaeologist Indiana Jones races against time to retrieve a legendary dial that can change the course of history. Accompanied by his goddaughter, he soon finds himself squaring off against Jürgen Voller, a former Nazi.

annotations.text: The MCU generated more box office revenue in Phase 3 alone than the entire Harry Potter franchise.
James Bond has survived 6 different actors across 60+ years — the longest-running franchise.
Sequel fatigue is real: across all franchises, entry #4 and beyond average lower ratings than entry #1.
2019 was peak franchise: the majority of top-grossing films were franchise entries.
The Fast & Furious franchise grew its revenue per entry for 7 straight sequels — defying the typical decline.
Christopher Nolan's Dark Knight trilogy averaged a 8.5 rating — the highest-rated Batman continuity.
Spider-Man has been rebooted 3 times, each with a different lead actor and distinct rating trajectory.
Toy Story maintained a 7.5+ rating across all 4 entries — one of the most consistent franchises in quality.
